semantics.partition: Fix L1 union event IDs before conditions; same classification at both horizons.
semantics.count_overlap: unknown_n and censored_n overlap; eligibility exclusions can overlap both. None is loss.
semantics.stock_counts: distinct_stock_n counts event-bearing stocks within this summary; do not add across cells or years.
semantics.zero_denominator: Rates and bounds are null when their denominator is zero.
semantics.references: At most three deterministic input event references per cell; not a representative sample or a file/URL locator.
semantics.provenance: Caller assertions only. input_structure_verified means in-memory contract checks, not authentic-market-input certification.
semantics.research_scope: Synthetic and pilot cells are not evaluated research conclusions; historical exposure never becomes unseen validation.
